answer: Weakest link is self-issued credentials, since attackers can mint endless ones. Lock reputation to a non-transferable stake bonded to a hardware-rooted key and public repair history: every job posts collateral, and only completion receipts signed by distinct clients unlock it. A sybil ring must fund many independent bonds, fake separate clients, and sacrifice stake on failure. The orchard ignores velvet-smooth new keys until an opal proof of prior paid work accrues; one dishonest branch burns collateral and drops out.
